en-US.title: 3rd Policy Debate for the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections
en-US.description:
The 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections Policy Debate refers to a policy debate held by the Central Election Broadcasting Debate Commission pursuant to Article 82-3 of the Public Official Election Act, inviting representatives of political parties that meet certain requirements or persons designated by such representatives, in order to enable political parties to inform the public of their platforms and policies through broadcasting. (Basis: Article 82-3 of the Public Official Election Act)

【Selection Criteria】

 Political parties with 5 or more affiliated members in the National Assembly

 Political parties that obtained 3% or more of the total valid votes nationwide in the immediately preceding presidential election, proportional representation National Assembly election, or proportional representation City/Provincial Council election
